title: Replace Words
summary: Shorten every word in a sentence to the shortest dictionary root it starts with.

tests.explain: "unhappy" starts with "un", "readers" and "reruns" with "re", and "prefer" with "pre".
Every word made of a's starts with all three roots; the shortest, "a", wins. "b" has no root and stays.
No word starts with "xyz", so the sentence is unchanged.

args: ccaea cbdd dbbdd ad e cea acedeae aead abceb aaac a baaeb cdbc ddebbcc acddedb eeb dddd bbeeaa abd ca ccce eeeccb cdeddc aadbcea e bbdc cd deccea aebe e
tests.expected: c c d ad e c acedeae aead abceb aa a b c d acddedb eeb d b abd c c eeeccb c aa e b c d aebe e

hints: For each word you need the shortest root that is a prefix of it. Checking every root against every word is slow.
Put all the roots in a trie. Walking a word down the trie passes exactly the roots that are its prefixes, shortest first.
Walk each word letter by letter: stop at the first node marked as the end of a root and use that prefix. If the path breaks off first, keep the word unchanged.

complexity.time: O(D + S): D letters to build the trie, then at most one trie step per letter of the sentence
complexity.space: O(D) for the trie, plus O(S) for the output
